find: Nineteenth-century novel questions are typically split into two tasks. An extract-based task gives you a passage of about 400 words and asks how Shelley uses language and/or structure to present an idea, character, or theme (rewarding AO1 + AO2). A wider-text task asks you to explore a theme, character, or idea across the whole novel (also AO1 + AO2). Most GCSE literature exams are closed book, so you must memorise key quotations — check your exam board’s specimen paper for the exact mark weightings and timing.
